instruction: Auto-fit all columns to their content width so the data is properly visible.

metadata.explanation: Task requires auto-fitting all data columns (C-H contain data based on file analysis). Evaluator verifies all 6 data columns (C, D, E, F, G, H) have been resized from default width using tolerance-based comparison.

llm_judge_reasons: Coverage: Evaluator correctly checks all 6 data columns (C-H) with min_changes=6, ensuring complete task verification.
Specificity: Evaluator restricts checking to data_columns list (C-H), preventing false positives from resizing non-data columns.
Robustness: Uses tolerance-based comparison (0.1) for default width detection, handling floating-point precision issues.

Minor limitation: Cannot distinguish between auto-fit and manual arbitrary resizing. Both will pass as long as widths differ from default. However, this is practically acceptable as the task goal (making data visible) is achieved either way.
State handling: Postconfig saves file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation, ensuring column width changes are persisted to disk for openpyxl to read.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional enhancement: Could verify widths are within reasonable bounds for typical content (e.g., 5-50 character widths), though current approach is pragmatically sufficient.
